title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (P300) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: This dataset contains 64-channel EEG recorded at 1000 Hz from 31 healthy participants, each across three sessions, during a row/column P300 speller task. It is the P300 component of a multimodal collection that also includes eye-tracking and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms. Target and non-target flash events are annotated with HED, and the data are organized in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap (65 channels) and SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz, referenced to the right mastoid (M1) with a forehead ground. Participants performed a visual row-column P300 speller with 4L and 5L grid sizes, giving 40 trials per session in the default 4L configuration, offline and without feedback.
